## What this does and does not establish

VERIFIED — the Docker sandbox. Isolation flags, mount semantics, the uid the
container runs as, environment construction, timeouts and the pid ceiling are
all exercised against real containers started by the product's own
`DockerSandbox`.

VERIFIED — the compose file parses and every reference in it resolves.

BLOCKED_EXTERNAL — `docker compose up -d` and `docker build`. Both need base
images from Docker Hub, and this environment's egress policy answers 403 to the
registry's blob CDN (`production.cloudfront.docker.com`). That is an
organizational network policy, not a defect in Meridian and not something to
route around, so the deployment path is unverified here rather than passing or
failing. What is verified is everything that does not require pulling: the
compose file's validity, the Dockerfile's structure, and every runtime behaviour
of the sandbox it configures.

The sandbox image used above was assembled from binaries already on this machine
(`node scripts/build-sandbox-image.mjs --offline`). It carries a shell and a
handful of utilities and nothing else. It is adequate for verifying isolation
and is not a substitute for the real sandbox image, which carries the toolchain
an agent actually needs.
